subject: Thank you for applying to Acme Corp!
snippet: Thanks for applying to the Senior Backend Engineer position at Acme Corp. We've received your application and will be in touch soon.
bodyText:
Hi Arshita,

Thank you for applying to the Senior Backend Engineer position at Acme Corp. This email confirms that we have received your application.

Our team reviews every application carefully. If your background is a match, a recruiter will reach out within the next couple of weeks.

Thanks again for your interest in Acme Corp.

Best,
Acme Corp Talent Team

subject: Your application to Nimbus Data
snippet: We received your application for the Data Platform Engineer role at Nimbus Data. Our hiring team will review it shortly.
bodyText:
Hello,

We received your application for the Data Platform Engineer role at Nimbus Data.

Our hiring team reviews every application and we will follow up if there is a fit. Thank you for your interest in joining Nimbus Data.

- Nimbus Data Hiring Team

subject: Application received: Initech
snippet: Thank you for your interest in the Product Manager position at Initech. Your application has been submitted successfully.
bodyText:
Dear Candidate,

Thank you for your interest in the Product Manager position at Initech. We received your application and it is now under review by our recruiting team.

We will contact you if we would like to move forward.

Regards,
Initech Talent Acquisition

subject: Let's schedule an interview - Acme Corp
snippet: We'd love to schedule a phone screen with you for the Senior Backend Engineer role. Are you free this week?
bodyText:
Hi Arshita,

Thanks for your patience! We reviewed your application for the Senior Backend Engineer role at Acme Corp and would love to schedule a phone screen with our engineering manager.

Could you share your availability this week for a 30-minute call?

Best,
Priya Shah
Acme Corp Recruiting

subject: Nimbus Data: phone screen next steps
snippet: Great news - we'd like to set up a phone screen for the Data Platform Engineer role. Please pick a time below.
bodyText:
Hi Arshita,

Great news! We'd like to schedule a phone screen for the Data Platform Engineer position at Nimbus Data.

Please use the link below to pick a 30-minute slot that works for you this week.

Looking forward to chatting,
Jordan Lee
Nimbus Data Recruiting

subject: Update on your application to Acme Corp
snippet: Thank you for taking the time to interview with us. Unfortunately, we have decided to move forward with other candidates.
bodyText:
Hi Arshita,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with our team about the Senior Backend Engineer role.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely matches our current needs. Unfortunately we will not be proceeding further at this time.

We appreciate your interest in Acme Corp and wish you the best in your search.

Best,
Acme Corp Recruiting

subject: We're pleased to offer you a position at Initech
snippet: Congratulations! We are pleased to offer you the Product Manager position at Initech. Please find the offer letter attached.
bodyText:
Dear Arshita,

Congratulations! We are pleased to offer you the Product Manager position at Initech.

Please find your official offer letter attached, along with details on compensation, start date, and benefits. Let us know if you have any questions.

Welcome to the team,
Initech HR
